name: Pooled PCA + cluster + factor analysis of DSI>0.7 / PD>10 cells across 4 seeds
short_description: Pool DSI>0.7 ∧ PD>10 Hz cells from t0106 (s44), t0112 (s77), t0114 (s7755), t0115 (s9354); PCA + KMeans on electrophys (54-d) and morphology (14-d) subspaces + factor analysis on the full 68-d vector.
